title: Promoter mutation footprints
description: Signed per-base information footprints for four measured promoters in LB and anaerobic conditions. Actual wild-type bases are retained for inspection.
reference: Author-synthesized 160-base E. coli promoter fragments; library-relative positions
processing: Read author-repository information_footprints files, preserving every pos and signed info value. Join by the exact promoter name to the author wild-type sequence table. Position is the zero-based index within the 160-base synthesized library fragment. The author footprint pipeline computes information in bits and carries expression-change direction as its sign. No genomic liftover or new motif calls are performed.
coordinateSystem: 0-based promoter-fragment index, not an absolute genome coordinate
limits: Four selected promoters and two conditions; not all 113 promoters or all study conditions.
Library positions are not absolute reference-genome positions.
Signed information is a processed inferential footprint, not a measured binding affinity.
The supplied original wild-type sequence is used as reported; fragment offset or trimming is not independently remapped here.
